review.supports: Native C#/asset review and explicit distinctions between cargo, PASS, civilian visitors, controller registry and hull lifetime.

role_native.supports: Actual role constructors and control-tree routing, GetTarget selection, x/x station choice, hidden reserve eligibility, virtual home dispatch, and FFWD outcomes with stated fixtures. Production coordinate transpiler fixes both regional calls, preserving remembered-partner, existing-route, Hold timer and success/failure/Running behavior.

conversion_native.supports: Native shallow unmooring with production scopes preserves independent/copied goals, rebinds direct Ship goals, clears retired references and handles failure/nesting without changing routes, fuel or momentum. Unmoor/pushback and stellar materialization remain fixture boundaries.

economy_native.supports: Existing native production/market and production-patch tests cover chronological dispatch/delivery, conservation and eligible freight; numerical planning inputs are prescribed.

lifetime_native.supports: Production permanent-removal and load restoration, replacement integrity, preserved momentum and fuel; does not establish stellar conversion correctness.

arrival_native.supports: Native Dock versus DockCargoAndDespawn arrival, crew movement/rejection and market callback differences under stated fixture boundaries.

return_native.supports: Existing station-return priority and native leaf integration under controlled inputs; not a complete cargo manifest policy test.

region_native.supports: Normal native ATC selection, registration and Update reproduce destructive cleanup in 44 baseline cases. Repaired controls cover eight roles, full/shallow direct/chained groups, repeated boundaries, primitive controller/blackboard serialization, local/remote detach, ownership change and crewless faction captures. Actual RunAIQueue/Fill/Dequeue execute; AI leaf execution and Unity/terminal CO teardown are observed fixture boundaries. Existing crew-integrity hooks are included in five integration cases.

visit_native.supports: Production hooks execute native root/sticky/priority/reaction scheduling, retirement notification, SFF role gating, saved-target registration, native save paths and unpatched-tree restoration. Deferred reuse, ordinary retargeting, low-fuel home, station-only parking and hauler-tow exclusions are checked. Physical flight, retirement CO movement and numerical affordability remain explicit boundaries. Unchanged validation allocates zero bytes over 5000 calls.

controller_identity_native.supports: Native station collisions create cross-region duplicates; saved records retain both; local cleanup destroys the shared cargo hull while its market survives. Production reuse/load correction and native cargo delivery are verified offline. Ship/pilot construction, damage and Unity retirement services have explicit fixtures.
